text: 科瑞技术公告，公司拟向特定对象发行股票，发行对象不超过35名（含本数），募集资金总额不超过7.52亿元（含本数），其中6.32亿元用于超高精密度零部件基地建设及相关设备扩产项目，1.2亿元用于补充流动资金。本次发行相关事项已获第五届董事会第七次会议审议通过，尚需股东会审议、深交所审核及中国证监会同意注册。
text_en: Kerui Technology announced that the company plans to issue shares to specific targets, with no more than 35 subscribers (inclusive), raising a total of no more than 752 million yuan (inclusive), of which 632 million yuan will be used for the ultra-high-precision components base construction and related equipment expansion project, and 120 million yuan for supplementing working capital. The relevant matters of this issuance have been approved by the seventh meeting of the fifth board of directors and still require shareholder meeting approval, Shenzhen Stock Exchange review, and CSRC registration consent.
